name: Cadavre
source:
Cadavre is a short horror game about Roy, a man who has a corpse in his yard. And it's a problem.

[From [url=https://darksummer0953.itch.io/cadavre]itch.io[/url]]

《Cadavre》是一款短篇恐怖遊戲。一個叫羅伊的男人院子裡有具屍體。這可成了個問題。
